# clavis access explain

<p class="cli-lead">Explain why a user or group has access</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis access explain <user|group> [flags]
```

</div>

Explain why a member or group does or does not have a permission, step by step through roles and groups.

## Examples

```sh
clavis access explain ada@example.com --permission secrets:write --env prod
clavis access explain platform-team --permission secrets:read-values --project web-app
```
